major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it only once Blade Dance and Eye Beam are both already on cooldown so Chaotic Transformation resets them, with no Annihilation or Death Sweep Demonsurge procs left unspent, entering on as much Fury as you can hold and leaving with as little as possible.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 200166 is the cast id observed in the sampled parse; 191427 is the 2 min talent/tooltip id and 162264 is the demon form aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Eye Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it as often as possible for the Demonic window and Cycle of Hatred stacks, which ramp the cooldown down to 22.5 and then 20 seconds, and only commit when you can finish the full channel since the Furious Gaze and Eternal Hunt follow-ups are lost otherwise.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Demonic Intensity replaces it with Abyssal Gaze (452497) during Metamorphosis; both share this cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: The Hunt
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every minute outside Essence Break windows and follow it straight into Eye Beam to spend the Empowered Eye Beam buff, holding it on Aldrachi Reaver until any active Reaver's Glaive is consumed.
major_cooldowns.id_note: base_cd_s is 90; the Eternal Hunt apex talent taken by both hero trees cuts it to 60, which matches the 8 casts in the sampled parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Essence Break
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open the 4 second window inside Metamorphosis at 35 or more Fury with Blade Dance about to come up, then fill every global with Death Sweep and Annihilation - Eternal Hunt buys you two Death Sweeps if you cast it after Eye Beam.

major_cooldowns.name: Immolation Aura
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep it rolling on 3 or more targets for Ragefire and as backup Fury generation, never sit at 2 charges with A Fire Inside, and drain to zero charges before Metamorphosis since Demonic Intensity refunds both for a double Consuming Fire.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 258920 is the cast id; 427912 is the self aura. A Fire Inside cuts the cooldown by 6 and adds a second charge.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it under 2 seconds before Eye Beam when Metamorphosis is less than 6 seconds out, or alongside The Hunt when Eye Beam is more than 6 seconds away, and never inside an Essence Break window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket, not an ability; talent_gated so players without it are not flagged.

rule.description: Open Eye Beam into The Hunt, then Metamorphosis
rule.action: Pre-pull Immolation Aura, then open Eye Beam into The Hunt and Felblade, and only press Vengeful Retreat straight into Metamorphosis once Eye Beam and Blade Dance are both on cooldown.

rule.description: Eye Beam spent before every Metamorphosis
rule.action: Spend Eye Beam and Blade Dance before you press Metamorphosis - Chaotic Transformation resets both, so pressing it early throws away two free casts.

rule.description: The Hunt into an empowered Eye Beam
rule.action: Follow every The Hunt with Eye Beam to cash in the Empowered Eye Beam buff Eternal Hunt grants, which doubles that beam's damage and widens it.
Hold Essence Break for demon form at 35 or more Fury; the bonus Haste fits roughly 4 casts into the 4 second window, and Eternal Hunt lets two of them be Death Sweep.

rule.description: Vengeful Retreat before every Eye Beam
rule.action: Time Vengeful Retreat right before each Eye Beam window and return with Felblade, or Fel Rush if it is down, so Initiative and Inertia are both live for the beam.
Bank Fury going into Metamorphosis so you can spend aggressively on Annihilation and Death Sweep from the first global, and aim to exit demon form near empty.
